run_split_train_valid: run the script to split a large document file into train and valid sets using reservoir sampling
run_reservoir_sampling: run reservoir sampling to select k random documents from a large file while respecting document boundaries
run_document_splitting: run the script to split documents separated by empty lines into sample and remainder output files
run_cli_split: run the CLI tool with input file, sample output, remainder output, and k parameter for document splitting
review_update_sample: review the update_sample function that implements reservoir sampling logic for selecting k documents from a stream
